usage.outputShape: body.results[] (array of search results), body.resultCount, body.source, body.query, body.timestamp
quirks: Charges $0.003 per call via x402 on Base but the duckduckgo upstream returns resultCount:0 and an EMPTY results[] for every query tested, including high-signal terms like 'OpenAI'. You pay and get no search data back. Do NOT use — it is non-functional as a web search.

Returns HTTP 200 with a well-formed JSON envelope ({query, resultCount, results[], source:'duckduckgo', timestamp}) so it LOOKS like it works on status code alone; you must inspect results[] which is always empty.
usage.guide: This endpoint is effectively broken: POST to https://web-search.api.klymax402.com/api/search with body {query, count} pays $0.003 USDC on Base and returns a 200 with valid JSON shape, but body.results[] is always empty (resultCount:0) even for common queries like "OpenAI". Do not rely on it for web search — it charges without returning any results. If retesting, check body.results[] length, not just the HTTP status.
